summary: Keep thread preview evidence message timestamps on the production renderer clock

replay.detail: Only the ignored preview evidence fixture changes; no durable data is replayed.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: Thread authority and mutation rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Production behavior is unchanged; fixed-clock unit fixtures remain deterministic.

manual.detail: The ignored thread_preview_evidence harness now captures a message accepted two minutes before rendering and asserts its relative label, instead of rendering a 1970 fixture against today's wall clock.

recovery.detail: Preview evidence writes captures only and changes no daemon state.
